Why Tyler businesses miss calls

Tyler draws patients and customers from across East Texas, so many callers are not local and may be phoning from the road. Education and health care employ nearly 30% of workers, by far the largest share, and retail adds over 12%. Hospitals, clinics and the University of Texas at Tyler create steady demand for nearby services, while hot summers and spring storms can bring urgent calls for contractors. In October, the Texas Rose Festival brings extra visitors to restaurants and shops. Small teams here often cover the front desk and the work itself, so calls go unanswered at the busiest moments.

Which Tyler businesses benefit most?

  • Medical offices: Patients from nearby towns can book or reschedule at any hour.
  • Dental offices: Front desks can stay with the patient in front of them.
  • HVAC and contractors: Hot summers and storms can bring urgent calls while crews are on jobs.
